QuestInfo.0: I received permission to go all the way to #m270030500#.  If I want to go beyond that, I need to take a test.  I should go to #b#p2140000##k to receive the test.
QuestInfo.1: #p2140000# said if you wish to go any further, you must go to #b#m270030500##k and eliminate the temple guardian, #r#o8220006##k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated #o8220006#. #p2140000# granted me permission. I should be able to go past the Road to Oblivion now.

no.0: That's too hard for you? That's too bad then. I guess that's just your limit.

1.0: You've defeated #o8220006#. That's amazing. I will grant you the permission as promised.
